name: Anthropic

source.quote: In 2023, 2024, and 2025, our revenue was $41 million, $386 million, and $4.6 billion, respectively, representing year-over-year growth rates of 841% and 1,088%, respectively.
Anthropic, an American AI company, has raised US$ 65 billion in a Series H funding round at a US$ 965 billion post-money valuation.

description: Maker of the Claude AI models; a public benefit corporation that filed for a Nasdaq IPO in October 2026.
explain: Anthropic is funded mainly by Amazon and Google, which are also its biggest cloud suppliers, so much of the money they invest flows back to them as computing spend.
